speak.title: Role-play: a first phone for a ten-year-old
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: Your daughter is ten and wants a phone. You want a simple one with calls and a camera but no social media. Explain your reasons and ask what your friend thinks.

b.text: Your son has a full smartphone. You think a limited phone may make a child feel left out. Say what worries you, but listen to your friend's reasons.

phrases: I'd rather she didn't have social media yet.
I'm worried she'll feel left out.
That's a fair point, but safety matters more to me.
Couldn't we try it for a few months?
I'd be happy to review the rules when she's older.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the two friends agree, and what was the compromise?
